title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Recovery Standard — Reversing an Orthodontic Payment
content:
**Reversal and recovery of orthodontic payments under the Orthodontic Benefit Riders.**

## Clauses in force

1. **Look-back.** A reversal is made no later than the rider's recovery look-back period after the payment date of the payment being reversed. The period is 365 calendar days on every Cascade Ortho Rider. A payment older than that stays paid.
2. **Form of a reversal.** A reversal references the payment it reverses and recovers the amount from the payee. From a practice it is offset against future payments to that practice; from a member it is billed to the member. Each payment can be reversed once.

## Clause no longer in force

The following clause is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis for the grounds and amount of a reversal:

- *Retired:* "A payment is reversed when it was issued for a service period beginning after the rider termination date, when it duplicates a payment for the same case and service period, or when it took lifetime benefits above the maximum; it is reversed for its full amount, or, for the last case, for the excess only."

## The look-back clock

| Element | Value |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | the payment date of the payment being reversed, as shown on the system payment record |
| Counting | calendar days after that payment date |
| Comparison | the reversal date must be not later than the end of the look-back |
| Boundary | the 365th calendar day after the payment date is still inside the look-back |
| Outside the look-back | the payment stays paid |

The payment record consulted is the one the reversal refers to. Its payment date in the system, not a date the customer gives, starts the clock.

*Hypothetical boundary cases:* for a payment dated on a given day, a reversal on the 365th calendar day after it is within the look-back. A reversal on the 366th calendar day is not, and the payment stays paid.

superseded_clauses: A payment is reversed when it was issued for a service period beginning after the rider termination_date, when it duplicates a payment for the same case and service period, or when it took lifetime benefits above the maximum; it is reversed for its full amount, or, for the last case, for the excess only.
